# litert-ocr

> OCR for photos and screenshots in the browser and in Node.js, Deno and Bun, with the same API as tesseract.js 7 (createWorker, worker.recognize, worker.terminate); PDFs, scans and photos to Markdown with tables, JSON or text (convert); a JSON Schema filled from a document by an on-device LLM in the browser (litert-ocr/extract); a CLI (npx litert-ocr file.pdf) and an MCP server (npx litert-ocr mcp). PP-OCRv6-Small on LiteRT.js: WebGPU when the browser has it, else WebAssembly; files stay on the device, and after the first result the browser caches every model file, so later visits read offline. Tested in Chrome on macOS and Android, and in WebKit (the engine of Safari). Independent project, not affiliated with Google.

```js
import { createWorker, convert } from 'litert-ocr';   // was: from 'tesseract.js'
const worker = await createWorker('eng');
const { data } = await worker.recognize(image); // URL, File, Blob, <img>, <canvas>, ImageBitmap, ImageData, Buffer, file path
console.log(data.text);
await worker.terminate();

const { content, document } = await convert(pdfOrImage, { to: 'md' }); // 'md' | 'json' | 'text'; document.pages[].status
```

```sh
npx litert-ocr scan.pdf --md                      # exit 0 all pages read, 2 unreadable input, 3 a page empty or failed
claude mcp add litert-ocr -- npx -y litert-ocr mcp  # tools: convert_to_markdown, convert, ocr_image, list_input_formats
```

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/README.md): install, the one-line switch from tesseract.js and what differs, documents to Markdown and JSON, extract, the CLI and the MCP server, options, output formats, model and runtime files, threads (COOP / COEP), errors and their next steps, offline use, Safari and WebGPU, measured speed and accuracy with browser, device and date.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/AGENTS.md): for coding agents. Task → API → file.
- [examples/pdf-to-markdown/index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/examples/pdf-to-markdown/index.html): PDF, scan or photo to Markdown in the browser.
- [examples/mcp/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/examples/mcp/README.md): the MCP server for Claude Code and Claude Desktop.
- [examples/html/index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/examples/html/index.html): plain HTML with the CDN import.
- [examples/react-vite/src/App.jsx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/examples/react-vite/src/App.jsx): React with Vite.
- [examples/nextjs/app/ocr.jsx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/examples/nextjs/app/ocr.jsx): Next.js App Router client component.
- [src/core/types.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/src/core/types.ts) and [src/doc/types.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/litert-ocr/main/src/doc/types.ts): every option and result field, documented.
